title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Premieres First Episode to Rave Reviews
content: Even before this year’s Anime Expo, Cyberpunk: Edgerunners ‘ highly anticipated sequel was preparing anime fans to return to Night City. Specifically, the Netflix exclusive released a new trailer along with a look at the new characters who are picking up the baton from David and Lucy following their tragic tale.
author: ComicBook

title: JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure: Steel Ball Run Stage 2 Teases New Characters (Including Anime’s Big Bad)
content: As a part of this year’s Anime Expo, many Joestar fans’ dreams came true. Not only did JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure: Steel Ball Run confirm when the second stage of the cross-country horse race would arrive, but it also confirmed that Netflix was taking a weekly approach to the anime’s comeback.

title: 'Hitoribocchi no Isekai Kouryaku' Second Season in Production
content: Production company GREE Entertainment announced a second season for the Hitoribocchi no Isekai Kouryaku ( Loner Life in Another World ) television anime on Saturday, revealing an announcement visual (pictured).
author: MyAnimeList

title: The Detective Is Already Dead Season 2 Reveals New Trailer, Theme Songs, Character Visuals
content: The Detective Is Already Dead Season 2 revealed its second main trailer, new character visuals, and opening and ending theme details ahead of its October 2026 release. The opening theme, “Kono Shinzou ni Hanataba wo” (A Bouquet for This Heart), is written, composed, and arranged by 40mP and performed by Kokorone.
author: Anime Corner

title: Loner Life in Another World Season 2 Officially Announced
content: Loner Life in Another World Season 2 anime has been officially announced, with the show set to return after over two years. The first anime season aired in Fall 2024. The announcement was accompanied by a new “Season 2 Confirmed” visual, which you can see below.

title: Chillin' in Another World with Level 2 Super Cheat Powers Season 2 Officially Announced
content: Chillin’ in Another World with Level 2 Super Cheat Powers officially announced a Season 2 anime, revealing a teaser visual and trailer.
